description: Add exercises with sets, reps, and weight to compute training volume per exercise and session total.

faqs.a: Sets × reps × weight (kg). It measures total work done, a key driver of muscle and strength progress.
Volume per exercise ÷ total session volume, shown as a percentage so you can see where your work went.
Higher is not always better — volume should rise gradually; jumps over ~10% per week raise injury risk.

howto: Press Add exercise for each lift in your session.
Enter name, sets, reps, and weight in kg.
Watch per-exercise volume and each share of the total.
Use the session total to track progressive overload.
title: Workout Volume Calculator
